name: Ravenol
note: Iron Lynx partner; the logo in the team's partner block links to ravenolitalia.it. Ravenol is the brand of Ravensberger Schmierstoffvertrieb GmbH, Werther, which German filings (cited by German Wikipedia) show as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Synto Holding GmbH, Werther; Synto Holding's owners are not identified in any source I could open (North Data lists only managing director Igor Shevchuk). Not rated: no sourceable owner.
